test.create(box)
test.create(box::/middle::gw)
test.create(box::/middle::trigger_pos)
middle.create(gw::/inner::trigger_pos)
inner.create(out)
middle.move(gw::/inner::out, out)
middle.destroy(gw::/inner::trigger_pos)
middle.destroy(gw)

test.destroy(box::/middle::trigger_pos)
test.destroy(result)
test.destroy(box)
